verdict.rationale: Real-time multi-user sync is a fair axis for a collaborative issue tracker, but nothing in the evidence documents teammates' changes propagating live across open sessions without a refresh. Community praise of 'instant' interactions concerns local UI speed, not cross-session sync. Webhooks are a developer building block for receiving changes, not the product's own live sync, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see teammates' changes reflected instantly across open sessions without refreshing
